scope: Post-open mechanism diagnostic on the already opened BLASTNet Case 5 trajectory. It asks whether the truth-aware v213 source-geometry alignment can be reproduced at proxy time from deployment-visible synthetic 2D observations and known reported geometry only. It is not a warm start, reconstruction method, fresh external gate, resource result, curved-ray result, or real-BOST result.
scientific_question: Can one fixed, untrained, observation-only low-64 coefficient proxy preserve the v213 strict separation of every passing virtual-ring nine-camera rig from every failing supplied nine-camera calibration?

opened_observation_generation.preprocessing: Reuse the frozen finite-only rectilinear interpolation to 32x16x16, zero outer boundary, and supported-interior zero-mean gauge, with no clipping or shifting.
opened_observation_generation.observation: For each opened full preprocessed density field, generate the complete noiseless 2D two-component straight-ray observation under the same physical operator used by the frozen supplied or virtual geometry. The field is used only to generate y and for post-proxy diagnostics; it is forbidden from the proxy input.
opened_observation_generation.proxy_barrier: The proxy function receives only the fixed low-64 reported-geometry response M and the already generated observation y. It receives no field, density coefficient, frame label, reference outcome, reconstruction, residual, parent metric array, or fitted statistic.

supplied_nine_failing.reference_outcome: 0/546 strict cells and 0/13 complete calibration groups at zero-start CGLS K16 in v208.

virtual_ring_nine_passing.reference_outcome: 546/546 strict cells and 13/13 complete rig groups at zero-start CGLS K16 in v209.

virtual_ring_twelve_diagnostic.role: diagnostic only; it cannot replace the virtual-nine family

fixed_subspace.inheritance: Exactly the v210/v213 fixed low-64 sine span, support, gauge, rank, reported geometry, and exact response M.

unique_proxy.name: unregularized_low64_moore_penrose_observation_proxy
unique_proxy.input: Only M and y after the observation barrier.
unique_proxy.coefficient_estimate: Compute the economy SVD M=U diag(s) V^T. Freeze tau=float64_epsilon*max(M.shape)*s_max and retain s>tau. The unique estimate is c_hat=V diag(1/s) U^T y. No ridge, truncation rank, scaling, threshold fit, clipping, fallback, or candidate choice is permitted.
unique_proxy.rank_rule: All 64 singular directions must exceed tau. Rank loss invalidates execution rather than authorizing a tuned truncation.
unique_proxy.geometry_gram: Use the same G_normalized=64*(M^T M/observation_scalar_count)/trace(M^T M/observation_scalar_count) as v213.
unique_proxy.frame_metric: Insert c_hat into the frozen v213 harmonic metric h_hat=||c_hat||^2/sum_i((v_i^T c_hat)^2/max(lambda_i,64*float64_epsilon)).
unique_proxy.strict_separation_gate: min(primary over all 13 virtual-ring nine-camera rigs) must be strictly greater than max(primary over all 13 supplied nine-camera calibrations)
unique_proxy.pairwise_audit: Report all 169 virtual-nine versus supplied-nine comparisons; exact ties are not passes.

frozen_controls_and_diagnostics.source_blind_parent_control: Recompute the v210 trace-normalized low-64 Gram spectral floor and all 169 comparisons. It cannot replace the unique primary.
frozen_controls_and_diagnostics.observable_fit_residual: Report ||M c_hat-y||/||y|| for every frame and geometry; diagnostic only.
frozen_controls_and_diagnostics.truth_coefficient_agreement: After proxy output is sealed in memory, report relative coefficient error and cosine agreement against the opened low-64 truth coefficients; diagnostic only and forbidden from selection or the decision.
frozen_controls_and_diagnostics.virtual_twelve: Diagnostic only; cannot upgrade a failed virtual-nine primary.

execution_contract.camera_permutation_rule: Reversing camera blocks in M and y together must preserve coefficients, metrics, and residuals within 1e-10.

independent_validation.implementation: A second program must independently parse all 42 raw density files and grids, reproduce preprocessing without importing the formal preprocessor or v214 runner, build the low-64 span with SVD rather than QR, reconstruct supplied and virtual physical operators, regenerate full observations, and solve the proxy through the eigendecomposition of M^T M rather than the formal SVD. It must independently recompute every coefficient, residual, Gram, frame metric, geometry metric, family summary, pairwise decision, permutation audit, cost ledger, and input seal.

decision_order: Any parent mismatch, source/input drift, prohibited proxy input, non-finite value, low-64 rank loss, camera-permutation failure, missing frame/geometry, formal-independent mismatch, or output mutation gives INCONCLUSIVE_INVALID_OBSERVATION_SPECTRAL_PROXY_EXECUTION_V214.

If all 169 virtual-nine versus supplied-nine primary comparisons are strictly greater, conclude PASS_OBSERVATION_ONLY_SPECTRAL_ALIGNMENT_PROXY_STRICTLY_SEPARATES_CASE5_REFERENCE_V214. This authorizes only a separately frozen minimal warm-start feasibility test.
Otherwise conclude FAIL_OBSERVATION_ONLY_SPECTRAL_ALIGNMENT_PROXY_DOES_NOT_SEPARATE_CASE5_REFERENCE_V214 and close this fixed unregularized low-64 observation proxy.
Controls, diagnostics, virtual-twelve results, near misses, medians, post-hoc thresholds, or alternate inverses may never replace or upgrade the unique primary.
